meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 收到写 commit 的请求时，产出简短精准的提交信息，采用 Conventional Commits 格式：类型（如 feat、fix）加祈使式摘要，必要时在正文说明原因、破坏性变更等；只输出消息本身，不执行 git 操作。说“stop caveman-commit”或“normal mode”可恢复详细风格。
howto.when: 当你说“commit message”等请求，或使用 /commit、/caveman-commit 等命令时。

say.text: 帮我把改动写成提交信息，用 fix 类型，简要说明原因
say.note: 会得到一条符合格式的 commit 消息

say.text: 写一个包含 breaking change 说明的提交信息
say.note: 自动加上 BREAKING CHANGE 和正文

howto.what_en: When asked to write a commit, it outputs terse Conventional Commits messages: type plus imperative summary, body for why/breaking changes when needed. It never runs git commands. Saying "stop caveman-commit" or "normal mode" reverts to verbose style.
howto.when_en: Use for "write a commit", "commit message", or the /commit and /caveman-commit commands.

say_en.text: Write a commit message for these changes with a fix type and brief reason.
say_en.note: You'll get a properly formatted commit message.

say_en.text: Write a commit message that includes a breaking change explanation.
Write a commit for this diff with feat type and close #42.
say_en.note: Appends the issue reference at the end.
